title: 가게에서, 안내 방송에서: 앉으세요? 앉으십시오?
objective: By the end, you can attach -(으)세요 and -(으)십시오 correctly to verbs ending in a vowel, a consonant, or ㄹ, and choose the right one for a shop, a home, or a formal announcement.
summary: Learn to make polite requests with -(으)세요 for everyday talk and -(으)십시오 for very formal speech and announcements.

task.title: Make polite requests
task.line: Choose -(으)세요 or -(으)십시오 to suit the situation, attach the right form to each verb, and fix the mistakes.

forms.when: Everyday polite requests: in shops, at home, to a teacher or a stranger.
Same use as -세요. Add 으 after a consonant (not ㄹ).
forms.exampleMeaning: Please have a seat over here.

forms.when: Stems ending in ㄹ (만들다, 열다, 놀다) drop ㄹ and take the vowel forms, with no 으: 만드세요, 만드십시오.
forms.exampleMeaning: Make the gimbap like this. (cooking class)

forms.when: Very formal: announcements, signs, hotels, banks, speaking to a group.
Same use as -십시오. Add 으 after a consonant (not ㄹ).
forms.exampleMeaning: Please take off your shoes here.

watchOut: 앉세요 (X) → 앉으세요 (O): After a consonant you need 으.
만들으세요 (X) → 만드세요 (O): With a ㄹ stem, drop ㄹ and do not add 으.
전화하십시요 (X) → 전화하십시오 (O): -세요 ends in 요, but -십시오 ends in 오.
안녕히 있으세요 (X) → 안녕히 계세요 (O): A few verbs change their form: 있다 → 계세요, 먹다 → 드세요, 자다 → 주무세요.
exercises: Fill in the blanks with -(으)세요: ① 이 책을 ____. (읽다) ② 내일 다시 ____. (오다) ③ 문을 ____. (닫다)
Fill in the blanks with -(으)십시오 (announcements): ① 여기에서 표를 ____. (사다) ② 1층에서 가방을 ____. (찾다) ③ 창문을 ____. (열다)

Choose the better form for each situation: ① A very formal announcement on a plane: 모두 자리에 (앉으세요 / 앉으십시오). ② You, a customer at a café, to the staff: 아이스커피 하나 (주세요 / 주십시오). ③ You leave a friend's house. Your friend's family stays home: 안녕히 (가세요 / 계세요).
Find the mistake and correct it: ① 밥 먹기 전에 손을 씻세요. ② 물을 많이 마시십시요. ③ 공원에서 재미있게 놀으세요.
Write the request in Korean: ① At a hotel desk, ask a guest very formally to come in. (들어오다) ② At dinner, tell your friend's grandmother in everyday polite speech to eat a lot. (많이, 먹다)
answers: ① 읽으세요 ② 오세요 ③ 닫으세요
① 사십시오 ② 찾으십시오 ③ 여십시오
① 앉으십시오 ② 주세요 ③ 계세요
① 씻세요 → 씻으세요 ② 마시십시요 → 마시십시오 ③ 놀으세요 → 노세요
① 들어오십시오. ② 많이 드세요. (or 많이 잡수세요.)
